bodyHtml:
AQUASKY Successfully Completes ISO 9001:2015 Annual Audit in 2024 | Aquasky

We are pleased to share with our valued customers and partners that Aquasky has successfully completed the ISO 9001:2015 annual audit. This achievement shows our commitment to maintaining the highest standards of quality in our products and services.

What is ISO 9001:2015?

The International Organization for Standardization (ISO) is a globally recognized, non-governmental organization that brings together experts to develop international standards. These standards ensure quality, safety, and efficiency across various industries.

ISO 9001:2015 is an internationally standard that sets the criteria for a robust Quality Management System (QMS). It focuses on ensuring organizations consistently meet customer requirements and improve satisfaction through effective system management. Achieving this certification demonstrates Aquasky’s dedication to quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

 

What This Means for You

• Consistent Quality: Assurance that our products and services will consistently meet your expectations.

• Customer Focus: Our systems are designed to prioritize your needs, ensuring responsive and attentive service.

• Continuous Improvement: We are committed to ongoing enhancements in our operations, leading to better quality and service over time.

• Risk Management: A focus on risk-based thinking helps us address potential issues before they affect you.

 

Thank You for Your Support

We would like to take this opportunity to thank our customers and partners for your trust and support. Your feedback plays a crucial role in this process, and we encourage you to share your thoughts with us.

If you have any questions about our ISO 9001:2015 certification or would like to learn more, please reach out to Frank Wang at frankwang@aquasky.com.tw.

For more information about our other certifications, please visit: aquaskyplus.com/certification.
